tools.name: parky_find_experience
tools.description: Use this when a visitor names or describes a ride and you need its Parky ID, or to check which parks Parky covers. Park tools take a park name directly, so skip this for them. Searches only parks in Parky's current Disney and Universal release scope. It does not retrieve current wait times.

tools.name: parky_get_waits
tools.description: Use this when a visitor asks for current wait times, how long the lines are, or what is open or down at a Disney or Universal park, such as EPCOT, Magic Kingdom, Hollywood Studios, Animal Kingdom, Disneyland, Epic Universe or Islands of Adventure. Pass the park name as park_id; no lookup is needed.

tools.name: parky_get_hours
tools.description: Use this when a visitor asks about operating hours for one supported park within the next 60 park-local days. Schedule windows have guest-facing categories and labels; Early Entry is an eligibility-based window, not a separate ticketed event. These are reported schedules, which the operator may chan

tools.name: parky_get_crowd_outlook
tools.description: Use this when a visitor asks how crowded one supported park may be within the next 30 park-local days. Returns a forecast and range, not a guarantee or a live wait.

tools.name: parky_get_lightning_lane
tools.description: Use this when a visitor asks what Lightning Lane (or Universal Express) costs at one supported park on a date, or which rides have Lightning Lane return times available now and how soon. Return times exist only for today; prices cover the next 30 park-local days. Parky cannot buy or book Lightning L

tools.name: parky_get_best_time
tools.description: Use this when a visitor asks when to ride something to avoid long waits on a specific day within the next 30 days. Resolve the ride ID first. Returns hourly predicted waits with bounds, the typical wait by hour for that weekday, and the best and worst windows in park-local time; these are estimates,

tools.name: parky_get_ride_reliability
tools.description: Use this when a visitor asks how often a ride breaks down or which rides at a park are least reliable. Returns 30-day uptime percentage, outages per day, and average and longest outage, least reliable first.

tools.name: parky_get_ride_facts
tools.description: Use this when a visitor asks about a ride itself: height requirement, ride length, top speed, biggest drop, ride type, land, or whether it offers Lightning Lane. Also includes its live wait and 30-day reliability when available. Resolve the ride ID first. Facts vary by ride; missing facts are omitte

tools.name: parky_get_showtimes
tools.description: Use this when a visitor asks when a show, parade, fireworks or character meet happens at one supported park today or within the next week. Times are usually published for today only.

tools.name: parky_get_ride_outages
tools.description: Use this when a visitor asks whether or when a ride broke down: with ride_id, each outage of that ride over the last 1 to 30 days with start and end times; without ride_id, every outage at the park today including rides down right now.

tools.name: parky_get_park_conditions
tools.description: Use this when a visitor asks about the weather, storms, heat, lightning or weather alerts at one supported park right now, or how many rides are down. Weather is the National Weather Service's latest observation and alerts; it is current conditions, not a forecast.

tools.name: parky_get_ticket_prices
tools.description: Use this when a visitor asks what park tickets cost at a supported resort for a start date within the next year (walt-disney-world, disneyland-resort, universal-orlando, universal-studios-hollywood). Returns the prices Disney or Universal showed Parky on its last check. Parky cannot sell or book tic

tools.name: parky_get_park_availability
tools.description: Use this when a visitor asks whether a park has reservations or blockout dates for a ticket or pass type on given dates at a supported resort. Returns availability by segment (ticket or pass type) for up to 31 days. Ask for the fewest days you need; long ranges are large.

tools.name: parky_get_bus_times
tools.description: Use this when a visitor asks when the next Walt Disney World bus leaves a resort or stop for a park or Disney Springs. Pass a stop name or ID; without one, it lists the stops. Predictions come from Disney's own bus tracking.

tools.name: parky_get_event_nights
tools.description: Use this when a visitor asks about separately ticketed event nights at a supported resort, such as Mickey's Not-So-Scary Halloween Party, Disney Jollywood Nights or Halloween Horror Nights: which nights are on sale or sold out, and the lowest price. Covers up to 60 days. Parky cannot sell tickets.

tools.name: parky_list_parks
tools.description: Use this when you need every park Parky supports, with its key, time zone and Parky page.

tools.name: parky_list_park_rides
tools.description: Use this when a visitor wants every ride at one supported park, or to compare rides by height requirement, length, speed or Lightning Lane. Facts vary by ride; missing facts are omitted rather than guessed.

tools.name: parky_get_park_ride
tools.description: Use this when a visitor names a ride that exists at more than one park: it finds the ride by ID, name or slug within one park and returns the same answer as parky_get_ride_facts.

tools.name: parky_get_crowd_actuals
tools.description: Use this when a visitor asks how crowded one supported park actually was on recent days, or how accurate Parky's forecast has been.

tools.name: parky_get_ride_history
tools.description: Use this when a visitor asks how a ride's posted wait moved over the last week. Resolve the ride ID first. A row appears only when the wait or status changed, so a wait holds until the next row.

tools.name: parky_list_resorts
tools.description: Use this when you need every resort Parky supports, with its key, time zone and parks.

tools.name: parky_get_resort
tools.description: Use this when you need one resort's parks, time zone and aliases.

tools.name: parky_get_hotel_availability
tools.description: Use this when a visitor asks which hotels at a supported resort have rooms on given nights, or their lowest rates. Up to 14 nights within the next 120 days, as last checked; Parky cannot book hotels. Ask for the fewest days you need; long ranges are large.
